findings.title: Repeated attestations amplify a bounded input into tens of GiB of receipt parsing

reachable_example.receipt_content: Closed valid reference receipt padded with legal JSON whitespace to exactly 1 MiB; capture index hash updated. All data fabricated.

findings.expected: Schedule at most the one/two relevant distinct capture receipts; reject an invalid attestation list without work proportional to repetitions times receipt size. Preserve final INVALID_INPUT and documented precedence.
findings.actual_static: INTEGRITY loops over every unvalidated captureAttestations item and calls checkFile(..., true), reparsing the same receipt 40,000 times. The physical-file cache only deduplicates byte accounting; it does not cache parsing. Uniqueness/cardinality validation runs later at SCHEMAS. This constructs 41,943,040,000 receipt bytes of parser work from a 162,040-byte manifest and one 1 MiB receipt. This is a count derived from source, not a benchmark.
findings.impact: A locally supplied malformed manifest can stall qualification despite nominal file/aggregate caps.
findings.proposed_remedy: Bound or deduplicate the preflight receipt schedule before IO/parsing (retaining ordered diagnostics), cache parsed immutable receipt snapshots, and enforce exact attestation cardinality/uniqueness at the schema stage.
findings.closure_evidence: An isolated later regression with instrumented receipt reads/parse counts must show a constant small number of parses for a repeated-ID manifest; status INVALID_INPUT, no truncation, unsupported/integrity precedence preserved.

findings.title: Canonical expansion makes valid raw JSON fail as an invalid input during output
findings.expected: The raw array is valid, within input limits, finite, depth 1, and has no normalization policy. Equal authenticated sides must be compared completely. Materialize a complete projection within the approved report contract; if output cannot be materialized, classify the output failure INFRA_FAILURE/1 rather than INVALID_INPUT/1.
findings.actual_static: CVG-CANON-1 expands the 1,000,001-byte array to 4,400,001 bytes. output.write applies the raw MAX_FILE=4 MiB to this generated projection and throws inputError. The main catch preserves that INVALID_INPUT classification. Both equal inputs can therefore be rejected as malformed at COMPARISON solely because output grew.
findings.impact: Admissible numeric JSON produces the wrong terminal error and an unimplemented valid comparison boundary.
findings.proposed_remedy: Separate raw-input and generated-output policy/error handling. Materialize the complete canonical stream in bounded parts if supported by the approved normalized-list contract; seek an explicit contract clarification before changing its per-item limit. Never classify comparator-generated output failure as malformed evidence.
findings.closure_evidence: After the execution hold is lifted, cover the supplied numeric array on both authenticated sides, validate every output descriptor against the closed report schema, and inject a generated-output limit failure to assert INFRA_FAILURE. No input truncation or dropped values.

findings.title: Authority can expire after its final check and before report emission

reachable_example.preconditions: All bindings valid; authority expiresAt is future at invocation and at line 440.
reachable_example.schedule: Pause or delay one input snapshot write/fsync during lines 466-478 until the expiration passes, then resume.

findings.expected: APPROVED must be unexpired at report emission. The emitted report must be BLOCKED_CVG_SPEC/1 if expiration occurs before emission.
findings.actual_static: The last currentAuthority() check precedes all input snapshot writes and input-snapshots.json. Those awaited writes and fsyncs can take arbitrary wall time. report.json is then written with MATCH_REQUIRES_REVIEW/0 without another clock/authority check. Thus a receipt that expired during materialization can still authorize a newly emitted match report.
findings.impact: The persisted report can claim a current approved equivalence after its authorization window ended. Local synthetic scope limits current exposure; it still violates the frozen authority boundary.
findings.proposed_remedy: Materialize non-final evidence first, then re-evaluate authority at the final report publication boundary and serialize the resulting terminal status. Make the emission/commit instant explicit and apply the rule to all terminal paths that depend on current authority.
findings.closure_evidence: Use a controlled clock plus delayed output in the later executable phase: expiration during snapshot writes must yield BLOCKED_CVG_SPEC/1 in both the returned and persisted report; unexpired/null expiration controls retain their expected results.

findings.title: Output or cleanup failure can leave a saved MATCH report while returning INFRA_FAILURE

reachable_example.preconditions: An otherwise matching, authorized synthetic run.
faults: report.json writeFile completes, then that file fsync or close rejects.
report.json is fully written, then io.close rejects while closing the retained output directory handle.

findings.expected: Persisted terminal evidence and the returned/CLI terminal result must agree; incomplete output is visibly a failure and cannot be consumed as a completed match report.
findings.actual_static: The bytes serialized at line 479 already contain MATCH_REQUIRES_REVIEW/0. A later write sync/close failure reaches line 481, or cleanup reaches line 490, and mutates only the in-memory object to INFRA_FAILURE/1. There is no invalidation, failure completion marker, or persisted status correction. report.json can remain complete valid JSON claiming MATCH even though the CLI returns failure.
findings.impact: A reviewer consuming only the saved report can receive a different verdict from the command that produced it.
findings.proposed_remedy: Define an exclusive report publication/completion protocol: stage the terminal report, finish required snapshot/output IO and cleanup, and expose a completed report only when those operations succeeded. Make failure artifacts unmistakably incomplete; verify persisted status and returned status agree for each supported failure path. Do not overwrite prior evidence.
findings.closure_evidence: Later controlled fsync/close faults must show INFRA_FAILURE/1 and no completed saved MATCH report, including a failure after report bytes were written; retain the fault and partial artifacts as failure evidence.
